newsitem.title: THAILAND: Mitsui Co secures 11-bln baht Thai power deal.
newsitem.headline: Mitsui Co secures 11-bln baht Thai power deal.

text.p: Japan Mitsui & Co has secured an 11.08-billion-baht contract to engineer and supply an Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand (EGAT) power plant, an EGAT official said on Friday.
The company beat three other rival bidders, Mitsubishi Corp, Marubeni Corp of Japan and Siemens of Germany as it made the lowest bid.
The 1,800-megawatt combined cycle power plant power to be supplied by Mitsui will be built in western Thai province of Ratchaburi and is due to start in late 1998 and be fully operational in 1999.
The plant will have an ultimate generating capacity of 4,600 megawatt, 1,800 from combined cycle complex and 2,800 from thermal complex.
